rules.name: The pagan gods of the Ronnec
rules.lore: The terrifying deities of the Ronnec stride across the battlefield, unencumbered by gravity and unbothered by cannon fire. Where the go, raw destruction follows, and fear is left in their wake.
rules.text: Attacks made against enemy units which are within 6" of a friendly +Ronnec+ +Monster+ unit have their Armor Break trait improved by 1.

strategems.name: Interdimensional Resonance Cascade
strategems.when: After a +Ronnec+ +Monster+ unit from your army is destroyed
strategems.target: The +Necrons+ +Monster+ unit that was just destroyed.
strategems.effect: Every unit within 6" of the destroyed unit suffers d6 Mortal Damage

strategems.name: Atomic Erosion
strategems.when: At the start of the Battle Round
strategems.target: An enemy unit within 6" of a friendly +Ronnec+ +Monster+ unit
strategems.effect: The target unit must take a Battle-Shock test. Subtract 1 from the result. If the test is failed, the unit suffers D3+1 Mortal Damage.

strategems.name: Withering Fire
strategems.when: At the start of the battle round
strategems.target: An enemy unit within 6" of a friendly +Ronnec+ +Monster+ unit
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, attacks made against the target unit can re-roll Hit and Wound rolls of 1.
